# Julian Bernstein

Julian Bernstein is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2002.

Julian Bernstein has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/julian-bernstein#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 2 with 40.8% of the ballot.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/julian-bernstein#e7)

  Not elected.

* * *

* * *

## Election History

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Brelade No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade-no-2) (2 seats), 27th November 2002.

**Julian Bernstein was elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 2 in 2002**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Peter Troy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-troy)** |  | 961 | 61.2% |
| 2 | **Julian Bernstein** |  | 640 | 40.8% |
| 3 | [Jane Wakeham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jane-wakeham) |  | 599 | 38.2% |
| 4 | [Terry Coutanche](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-coutanche) |  | 397 | 25.3% |
| 5 | [Stefan Gough](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stefan-gough) |  | 193 | 12.3% |
| 6 | [Robert Partridge](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/robert-partridge) |  | 92 | 5.9% |

1,570 ballots (inc. 16 spoilt papers)

4,238 registered voters

= 37% turnout

### 2005 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Brelade No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade-no-2) (2 seats), 23rd November 2005.

**Julian Bernstein was not elected**.

| 2 | **[Peter Troy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-troy)** |  | 737 | 38.6% |
| 3 | [Steve Pallett](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett) |  | 667 | 34.9% |
| 4 | Julian Bernstein |  | 462 | 24.2% |

1,910 ballots (inc. 6 spoilt papers)

= 40.6% turnout
